summary_md:
# Förvaltaren: Svenska jättar att äga när det stormar

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Carnegie Fonder manager Mattias Sjödin was the guest on EFN Börslunch. He argued that despite market volatility and renewed US tariff threats, the economy is holding up and Swedish earnings should grow about 12% this year. He is less worried about valuing AI exposure than about US housing and rates. He favours quality Swedish large caps held in Carnegie Sverigefond: Elekta (turnaround), Essity (tissue divestment), Beijer Ref, Skanska (value case), Epiroc and Sandvik (mining equipment), plus Investor as the largest holding.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EKTA-B — Elekta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Q2 operating profit ~20% above consensus, cost savings over-delivering, cheaper than its history, possible buyout candidate.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Carnegie Fonder) holds Elekta and sees a trend break in the turnaround under CEO Bomholt. 500M SEK savings over-delivered, organic growth 5%, stricter order book criteria, no financial worries. Expects market estimates to rise, especially for revenue. Low valuation and strong market position make it a plausible take-private target.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gross margin pressure from long lead times and inflation worsens
- if competition erodes its #2 market position
- if the cost programme stalls

> *"Aktien är mycket billigare än historiskt. Det finns ingen finansiell oro runt bolaget."*

---

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Expected tissue divestment would make Essity a focused health and personal care company with margin upside. New chair, new CEO, Cevian on the register.

#### Reasoning

Guest has engaged with the company many times and is fairly convinced the tissue business will be divested, likely next year. That would leave a Mölnlycke-like, less capital-heavy company with re-rating and margin potential, from today's ~14x earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the tissue divestment is abandoned
- if energy and raw material cost inflation squeezes margins

> *"Jag är ganska övertygad om att det kommer att komma i mål."*

---

### 🟢 BEIJ-B — Beijer Ref | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Schörling family now main owner, EQT overhang gone, US Heritage platform matured. Capital-light HVAC growth.

#### Reasoning

Guest finds it attractive to own long term in Sverigefond. The share was pressured by EQT's exit and the acquisition-plus-share-issue. Now the US platform can drive growth through distribution acquisitions, margin expansion and refrigerant regulation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US housing weakness deepens
- if Fed rate hikes hurt US demand

> *"Men jag tycker den typen av bolag är attraktivt för Sverigefonden att äga långsiktigt här, som till exempel Beijer Refte."*

---

### 🟢 SKA-B — Skanska | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Value case: construction implicitly valued at ~40bn SEK while earning ~8bn, book-to-bill above 1, 4%+ margins, net cash.

#### Reasoning

Guest is 'otroligt nöjda' with the holding. Sum of the parts: 120bn market cap less ~60bn property/development and 10-15bn net cash leaves construction cheap. Order intake and margins are rising, driven by the US, infrastructure, data centres and defence, with strong cash flows.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order growth stalls
- if commercial property sales and occupancy deteriorate
- if construction write-downs return

> *"Så vi är otroligt nöjda med Skanska."*

---

### 🟢 EPI-A — Epiroc | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Orders and book-to-bill point to margin upside. Attractively valued against its history at around 20x earnings.

#### Reasoning

Guest holds both Epiroc and Sandvik. Epiroc lagged Sandvik on margins because of construction and mix, but the order trend supports margin expansion. Long-term metal demand is backed by AI and China. Sees the recent fall in metal prices as noise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices fall 50-60% and miners cut capex
- if China collapses

> *"Men Epiroc i dess historiska kontext är attraktivt värderad."*

---

### 🟡 SAND — Sandvik | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held. World leader in underground mining equipment, passes tariffs on quickly, has completed its margin catch-up.

#### Reasoning

Guest owns Sandvik alongside Epiroc for long-term mining demand. Sandvik has already done its margin catch-up, so it gets less upside emphasis than Epiroc. Tariff exposure is manageable.

#### Sell Triggers

- if metal prices collapse and mining capex is cut

> *"Det är två bolag som är världsledande på underjords gruvutrustning och det är Sandvik och Epiroc. Bägge dom äger vi."*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Largest holding in Carnegie Sverigefond. Premium justified by Patricia/Mölnlycke, a better view of active ownership, and hidden EQT value.

#### Reasoning

Guest says the 5% premium is partly explained by Patricia's value, a more positive market view of active ownership, and hidden value in EQT. Long-held and has beaten the market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the premium expands without underlying value growth

> *"Det är också att synen på Investors aktiva ägande har blivit mer positiv."*

---

### 🟡 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Large holding, handles tariffs nimbly through US production.

#### Reasoning

Guest says new tariff threats do not materially affect Atlas Copco unless the broader economy turns clearly negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tariffs push the economy clearly negative

> *"Och Atlas är väldigt agila på det."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Large holding, manages tariffs including Mexico. Competitors are equally exposed.

#### Reasoning

Guest sees tariff impact as temporary and manageable thanks to US production. Competitors are at least as exposed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tariffs escalate enough to hit the economy
- if Mexico tariffs hit trucks hard

> *"Men mig veterligt som jag förstått det på Volvo så är de duktiga på att hantera det."*

---
